title: The Mechanical Theory of Heat: Fifth Memoir on the Theory of the Steam-Engine
version: English collected edition of a memoir dated March and April 1856 in Poggendorff’s Annalen
lineage: Translated collected edition of the 1856 memoir; original German issues not separately inspected. Clausius records critical engagement, not universal acceptance.

passages.note: Printed pp. 136–138, especially opening footnote and the paragraph identifying Thomson’s March 1851 Royal Society of Edinburgh paper; p. 137 visually inspected
